name: letter_formal
description: Formal letter skeleton in Spanish, English (UK or US), French, German, Portuguese or Italian, in a formal, very formal or administrative register: sender and recipient blocks, the date written as each language writes it, subject line, and the salutation and matching closing for a named recipient or nobody in particular (Dear Sir or Madam / Yours faithfully, Dear Ms Smith / Yours sincerely, Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren / Mit freundlichen Grüßen, Madame, Monsieur / Veuillez agréer...).

surname.description: Default: the last word of name

position.description: French very formal: 'le Directeur' gives 'Monsieur le Directeur'

request.description: What is asked; SOLICITA in Spanish administrative letters

output.closing: Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de mes salutations distinguées.

catalog.source: original; salutation and closing rules from Cambridge Dictionary (UK faithfully/sincerely), The Gregg Reference Manual (US), DIN 5008 and Duden (German), service-public.fr model letters (French), RAE Diccionario panhispánico de dudas (Spanish)
